name: contact-us-form-to-notion-contact

trigger.trigger_note: Zapier-managed Forms (Interfaces) trigger — Zapier wires the form to this workflow itself; nothing external to repoint. NOTE: the classic Zap subscribes to the SAME form, so while both are enabled every submission creates a contact twice (the classic Zap creates blindly). Turn the classic Zap off immediately.

notion.note: New contacts are created with the Contacts default template (repo rule 5) via the createItemWithTemplate two-call pattern; existing contacts are patched with raw sdk.fetch fill-only writes.

tables.01JYEPSEARXB2Z6BJRCMFGXBC2: email -> contact-page-id map (owned by contact-emails-to-zapier-table). Read to resolve the submitter; a newly created contact's address is indexed immediately with Trigger Contact Creation: false.

replaces_classic_zap: When a new Contact Us form submission is created, save to Notion

cutover.classic_zap_disabled: PENDING — URGENT: both Zaps subscribe to the same form, so submissions are double-processed until the classic Zap is off (this durable dedupes via the email Table; the classic Zap creates blindly). Not machine-verifiable.
cutover.status: durable live and verified; classic Zap must be turned off

description: Contact Us form submission (Zapier Forms) -> upsert the person in Notion Contacts: resolve through the email->page-id Zapier Table, fill blanks on an existing contact (message added as a comment when Note is taken), or create one with the Contacts default template and index the address.
